text:
alex: FYI PR ready for security review — changes to auth flow for private clusters. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8423 please check token propagation and vault access paths. cc @jess @maria
jess: looking now. quick q — does this add any new cross-VPC egress rules?
alex: no new egress; it adds a conditional token exchange for service-to-service in private deployments. config diff: ```yaml
auth:
  enable_token_exchange: true
  vault_path: secret/data/priv-clusters/{{cluster}}
``` 
maria: noted. will run the static secrets scanner. @sec-bot can you kick off the scan?
sec-bot: auto-scan started for PR #8423 — results: found 1 high-risk vault path usage in tests (test fixture left hardcoded path). Details in CI report: https://ci.redwood.internal/scan/8423
alex: thanks — i'll remove the fixture in a follow-up commit. that's test-only, not shipped.
owen: quick read — overall looks good. request: add an explicit audit log event when token exchange occurs (helps compliance). small nit: update comment on the new env VAR.
jess: also please confirm KMS/HSM usage for private-deploy key wrapping. We need a short note in the PR description that private customers will use their own KMS.
alex: agreed. I'll add: "Private deployments: customer-managed KMS required; default disables key wrapping." 
maria: scanner cleared after test fix. @sec-bot final check?
sec-bot: final-scan: pass. no secrets in diffs, vault fixture removed. Advisory: ensure IAM role scoping is <= privilege needed.
owen: LGTM from infra side once audit event is added. Ready on my end for merge window @alex
alex: merging into canary branch now. plan: canary rollout to one private region at 02:00 UTC tomorrow, smoke tests for 30m. If green, full rollout next day.
jess: please post smoke test checklist in PR before merge (token exchange smoke, audit log entry, KMS behavior).
alex: done — added checklist and smoke commands: ```bash
# run smoke
./scripts/smoke-token-exchange.sh --cluster=priv-eu-1
``` 
maria: I'll monitor logs during canary. tagging security pager just in case: @sec-oncall
jess: thanks all :thumbsup:
alex: merging now, will notify when canary starts.
